semantics:
(* Specification notation; not a compiled Rocq development. *)
Definition Assertion := PermissionHeap -> Prop.
(* A heap maps logical cells to (share, value); 0 < share <= 1.
   Compatible heaps agree on overlapping values and sum shares <= 1. *)
Definition emp h := h = empty_heap.
Definition pure (P : Prop) h := P /\ h = empty_heap.
Definition sep P Q h := exists h1 h2,
  disjoint_join h1 h2 h /\ P h1 /\ Q h2.
Definition wand P Q h := forall h' h'',
  disjoint_join h h' h'' -> P h' -> Q h''.
(* Notation: !!P = pure P; P ** Q = sep P Q; P -* Q = wand P Q.
   EX v, P = existential assertion; ALL v, P = universal assertion.
   cell sh p f v h := p <> null /\ 0 < sh <= 1 /\
                     h = singleton (p,f) (sh,v).
   These are logical fields, not concrete C byte addresses/layout.
   entail P Q := forall h, P h -> Q h.
   {{P}} script {{Q}} is a resource-transform specification, with framing. *)

(* Ty_INV here means a representation invariant. It is not the complete
   Rust validity/aliasing model, nor a user-defined semantic type invariant.
   Explicit scalar model used in these runs: overflow checks disabled. *)
Definition Snap I32 := Z.
Definition Snap U32 := Z.
Definition Snap Bool := bool.
Definition Ty_INV_I32 (z : Z) : Prop := True.
Definition Ty_INV_U32 (z : Z) : Prop := True.
Definition Ty_INV_Bool (b : bool) : Prop := True.
Definition RustBound_I32 z := -2147483648 <= z < 2147483648.
(* RustBound is an extra obligation, not generated by a PCG edge. *)

Definition Own_I32 p z := cell 1 p Int_i32_val z.
Definition Own_U32 p z := cell 1 p UInt_u32_val z.
Definition Own_Bool p b := cell 1 p Bool_val b.
(* Scalar presentation schema, selected by the MIR type:
   OwnInt(T,p,v) := cell 1 p (val_field T) v, with v : Snap T.
   val_field I32 = Int_i32_val; I(p,v) is the local I32 abbreviation.
   An I64 extension selects Int_i64_val instead; it is not an extra run.
   cell is a logical field permission, not literally VST data_at.
   A C backend needs an address/layout/value/share correspondence, e.g.
   i32 -> data_at sh tint (Vint (Int.repr z)) p_C;
   i64 -> data_at sh tlong (Vlong (Int64.repr z)) p_C,
   when these C types implement the chosen Rust scalar layout. *)
Definition Own_T p s := Own_U32 (field p f) s.f.
(* s = {f := v} is a T snapshot; v alone is a U32 snapshot. *)
Definition Own_Point p v :=
  Own_I32 (field p x) v.x ** Own_I32 (field p y) v.y.
Definition Ty_INV_T s := Ty_INV_U32 s.f.
Definition Ty_INV_Point v := Ty_INV_I32 v.x /\ Ty_INV_I32 v.y.

(* Sized referents in the examples have unit metadata. *)
Definition Ty_INV_MutRef T r := type_of r.meta = Metadata T.
Definition DirectMut T p r :=
  cell 1 p Ref_mutable_addr r.addr **
  cell 1 p Ref_mutable_metadata r.meta ** !!(Ty_INV_MutRef T r).
(* DirectMut owns the reference representation, not its referent. *)
Definition R T p := EX v : Snap T, Own T p v ** !!(Ty_INV T v).
Definition R_mut T p := EX r, DirectMut T p r.
(* Own/Ty_INV dispatch to the concrete definitions above. *)

Parameter GenericOwn : forall T, Addr -> Snap T -> Assertion.
(* Abstract generic resource: the actual p_Param has no predicate body.
   Presentation refinement: GenericOwn T p v owns p_Param(T,p) and fixes
   its snapshot to box_T(v), where box_T is make_generic_s_T.
   Its implementation must be supplied/proved by the target backend.
   Conversion is a state transition, not a static logical equivalence. *)
Definition G T p := EX v, GenericOwn T p v ** !!(Ty_INV T v).
Rule concrete T p v :
  {{ GenericOwn T p v }} make_concrete T p {{ Own T p v }}.
Rule generic T p v :
  {{ Own T p v }} make_generic T p {{ GenericOwn T p v }}.
(* Both conversion contracts preserve the same snapshot v. *)

Definition Indirect (MutRef rho T) r rho := G T r.addr.
Definition Indirect (Container rho) c rho := G I32 c.x.addr.
Definition R_projection T s rho := Indirect T s rho.
(* For nested types, select matching region occurrences and recurse into
   fields/referents as supported by IndirectPredicatesEnc. This is not a
   claim that every Rust type is implemented. *)

(* Script vocabulary, specifications rather than Rocq tactics: *)
Rule unfold/fold D : exchange a named concrete predicate with its body.
Rule consume P : {{P}} consume P {{emp}}.
Rule assert A : {{P}} assert A {{P}} if P entails A with framing.
(* A local assert checks the current state; it does not inhale resources.
   requires/ensures describe the function entry/exit contract. *)
Rule assert_pure phi : {{P}} check phi {{P ** !!phi}}  if P entails phi.
Rule apply_wand P Q : {{P ** (P -* Q)}} apply_wand {{Q}}.
Rule package P Q F : {{F}} package(P,Q,script) {{P -* Q}}
  provided script establishes F ** P |-- Q for every admissible P-state.
(* Package captures a footprint F. It does not assume the wand for free. *)
(* pre/post below are local resource footprints; untouched resources frame.
   Wcap denotes PCG bookkeeping only, not an extra heap predicate. *)

definitions.scalar:
Definition q := addr(snapshot x).
Definition R_i32 p := EX z : Z, Own_I32 p z.
Definition G_i32 p := EX z : Z, GenericOwn I32 p z.
Definition Wcap p := PCG_capability(p) = Write. (* analysis fact *)
(* A source assignment supplies the new value; PCG supplies the schedule. *)
Rule assign_i32 p z : {{emp}} assign_i32 p z {{Own_I32 p z}}
  under the encoder's fresh/available-write-target discipline.
(* This models the generated assignment-method contract. A concrete C
   backend must instead retain/prove allocated writable storage. *)
definitions.field:
Definition q := addr(snapshot x).
Definition R_T q := EX n : Z, Own_U32 (field q f) n.
Definition Ty_INV_T n := True. (* this run has no overflow VC *)
Rule open_T q : {{R T q}} unfold Own_T {{R U32 (field q f)}}.
Rule close_T q : {{R U32 (field q f)}} fold Own_T {{R T q}}.
(* In test3 the field f is u32, not i32. No value equality is invented
   by folding: f = 4 comes from x.f = 4 and snapshot preservation. *)
definitions.call:
Definition p := addr(snapshot_at pre0 argument).
Definition q := addr(snapshot_at post1 result).
Definition y0 := (value_at pre0 Point p).y.
Definition RestorePoint := ALL z : Z,
  GenericOwn I32 q z -*
  (EX v, GenericOwn Point p v ** !!(v.x = z /\ v.y = y0)).
(* Logical presentation of an expiry snapshot binder: z is captured when
   the LHS is supplied. It is not the value at initial function return. *)
Definition CallPre := G Point p.
Definition CallPost := G I32 q ** RestorePoint.
(* Direct reference slots and result-slot storage are framed separately.
   Resource shape: type + PCG; equality pledge: user's after_expiry. *)
definitions.basic:
Definition p := addr(snapshot_at entry num).
Definition q := addr(snapshot_at return result).
Definition BasicPre := G I32 p.
Definition BasicPost := G I32 q ** (G I32 q -* G I32 p).
Definition Ty_INV_I32 (z : Z) := True.
Definition G I32 p := EX z : Z, GenericOwn I32 p z.
(* GenericOwn is abstract and related to Own_I32 by the two conversion
   contracts above. Lifetime names select resources; no clock is added.
   old(entry,num) fixes p, not the old integer stored at p. *)
definitions.chain:
Definition qx := addr(snapshot x).
Definition qy := addr(snapshot y).
Definition qz := addr(snapshot z).
(* Here qx = qy = qz = address(a); there is ONE referent resource.
   The PCG path records who may expose it, not three disjoint i32 cells. *)
Definition leaf_ready E e := forall n, blocked_by e n ->
  forall e', In e' E -> ~ blocks e' n.
Fixpoint plan fuel E :=
  if E = [] then [] else
  match fuel with
  | 0 => report_unresolved_dependency
  | S k => let ready := filter (leaf_ready E) E in
           if ready = [] then report_unresolved_dependency else
           map Remove ready ++ plan k (E \ ready)
  end.
(* E is the selected unblock subgraph, not an arbitrary whole PCG.
   Every removal must satisfy leaf_ready in the remaining graph.
   Package uses UnblockGraph; ordinary expiry also uses pack/remove. *)
Definition R_a := EX z : Z, Own_I32 (address a) z.
definitions.history:
Definition addr_at label place := addr(snapshot_at label place).
Definition NodeRes (Place p) := R (type_of p) (encode_place p).
Definition NodeRes (LifetimeProjection p rho) :=
  Indirect (type_of p) (snapshot p) rho.
Definition BaseExpr (Labelled p L) := old L (encode_place p).
Definition BaseExpr (RemoteArg i) := old entry (encode_argument i).
(* Labelled/Remote describe a node's base, not two extra PcgNode variants.
   old labels fix expressions/identities. Restored contents may be newer.
   Repeated projections of one address do not duplicate owned resources. *)
definitions.shared:
Definition rho_read : share := backend_read_share. (* 0 < rho_read < 1 *)
Parameter GenericRead : forall T, Addr -> Snap T -> Assertion.
(* p_Param at the backend read share, with snapshot box_T(v).
   This is not a claimed equality to concrete field cells. *)
Definition RefShared T p r :=
  cell 1 p Ref_immutable_addr r.addr **
  cell 1 p Ref_immutable_metadata r.meta **
  !!(type_of r.meta = Metadata T).
Definition DirectShared T p r :=
  RefShared T p r ** GenericRead T r.addr r.val.
(* GenericRead is the abstract generic predicate with backend read share.
   The shared-reference encoding exposes a value snapshot. No exclusive
   referent resource is minted for each shared Borrow edge. *)
Definition ResultValue s := s.pt.x.
(* result = pt.x is the user's ensures; sharing alone does not state it. *)
definitions.projection:
Definition Own_Container p c :=
  DirectMut I32 (field p x) c.x.
Definition Ty_INV_Container c := Ty_INV_MutRef I32 c.x.
Definition DirectContainer p := EX c, Own_Container p c.
Definition IndirectContainer c rho := G I32 c.x.addr.
(* The direct resource describes the reference-valued field. The indirect
   resource describes its referent. Projection expansion may organize the
   latter in the graph without emitting an executable proof operation. *)
Definition FutureProjection n := graph_placeholder n.
(* This is analysis metadata, not an allocated location or a new resource. *)
definitions.array:
(* Abstract sequence view of the array/slice resource. The actual backend
   uses generated index/frame methods; this is not their literal body. *)
Definition SeqOwn base vs := sep_list (map_with_index
  (fun i v => Own_I32 (element_addr base i) v) vs).
Definition SliceView base n vs := !!(length vs = n) ** SeqOwn base vs.
Definition IndexFrame base vs k := sep_list (map_with_index_except k
  (fun i v => Own_I32 (element_addr base i) v) vs).
Definition Ty_INV_Slice n vs := length vs = n /\ 0 <= n.
Definition Ty_INV_Array3 vs := length vs = 3.
Rule open_index : 0 <= k < length vs ->
  SeqOwn base vs |-- Own_I32 (element_addr base k) (nth k vs) **
                    IndexFrame base vs k.
Rule close_index : cell + frame reassemble with updated element value.
(* Cast/undo preserves base, length and current values. It does not restore
   the original sequence [13;37;72] after y[1] := 3. *)
definitions.branch:
Definition guard_a := path_taken(bb0, bb1).
Definition guard_b := path_taken(bb0, bb2).
Definition guarded g P := if g then P else emp.
Definition R_branch :=
  guarded guard_a (R I32 (address a)) **
  guarded guard_b (R I32 (address b)).
(* Exactly the executed branch is used. The untouched other cell is a
   frame, not a resource recovered again by both branches. *)
Rule guarded_recover g S : execute S only when g is true.
(* Mir-generated path flags, not a fresh unconstrained Boolean. *)
definitions.loop:
Definition LoopResources pcg := sep_list
  (map encode_capability (live_initialized_used_places pcg)).
(* encode_capability consults type and capability; W does not mean a
   readable initialized value. The sample has exclusive initialized i. *)
Definition I_resource := EX n : Z, Own_I32 (address i) n.
Definition I_value n := n > 2. (* user body_invariant, inside the guard *)
Definition I_body := EX n : Z,
  Own_I32 (address i) n ** !!(I_value n) ** !!(path_flags_hold).
(* Initial establishment and preservation are proof obligations. The loop
   invariant is located in the body, not blindly at the source while. *)
definitions.loopwand:
Definition long := address x.
Definition short L := addr(snapshot_at L r).
Definition W_loop L := G I32 (short L) -* R I32 long.
Definition I_loop L := G I32 (short L) ** W_loop L.
(* Additional direct locals and path assertions are framed here. *)
Rule loop_edge Add edge_to_loop :=
  if edge_to_loop then package W_loop using unblock_plan else skip.
Rule loop_edge Remove _ := apply_wand W_loop.
(* The displayed run fails with wand.not.found. I_loop is the intended
   resource protocol; it is NOT a proven invariant of this execution. *)
definitions.remote:
(* Schema for the List example, not a finished recursive-type encoding. *)
Definition p_entry := addr(snapshot_at entry self).
Definition q L := addr(snapshot_at L current).
Definition ListView p := GenericOwnExistential List p.
Definition GenericOwnExistential T p := EX v : Snap T, GenericOwn T p v.
Definition W_remote L := ListView (q L) -* ListView p_entry.
(* List's abstract resource represents head:u32 and tail:Option<Box<List>>.
   A C/VST implementation must define recursive nodes, ownership of Box,
   discriminants and layout, then prove the view conversions. We do not
   invent a concrete data_at/listrep correspondence here. *)
Definition RemoteResource := Indirect (type_of self) (snapshot_at entry self) rho.
(* Actual run: insufficient.permission. These are unproved obligations. *)
definitions.panic:
Definition unreachable : Assertion := !!False.
Rule prove_unreachable : {{P}} check False {{unreachable}}
  requires P |-- unreachable.
Rule cut_unreachable : {{unreachable}} assume False {{unreachable}}.
(* The actual output has exhale false before inhale false. This is control
   flow handling after panic, not resource acquisition from a PCG AddEdge. *)
definitions.flow:
Definition FutureProjection n := graph_placeholder n.
Definition Flow source target := analysis_dependency source target.
Rule ordinary_flow : {{P}} skip {{P}}.
(* P denotes exactly the framed assertion before the bookkeeping action.
   No unprovided GenericOwn resource is introduced by this skip.
   The generic type U has abstract GenericOwn U, not a guessed concrete body. *)
